task.title: Installing X-Author Contracts
task.shortdesc: X-Author for Contracts Cloud is a Microsoft Word add-in that requires a package installer. Alternatively,

context.p: X-Author for Contracts Cloud is a Microsoft Word add-in that requires a package installer. Alternatively, your DevOps team may also provide you an X-Author Contracts manifest file which you can configure or install in your Mac system to start using X-Author Contracts. This section would describe how to install X-Author Contracts on your Mac system using both the installer or the manifest file.
